t: A Somali Muslim state ruled by the Garen lineage, which claimed holy Arab descent, in the land between the Shabelle and Jubba rivers.
Its power rested on control of wells and river water, which it used to levy tribute from herders and farmers.
Revolts in the late 17th century broke it up, and the Hiraab Imamate and the Geledi took over its lands.
dyk: Many old stone-lined wells across southern Somalia are still attributed by local tradition to the Ajuran, centuries after the sultanate disappeared.
ev: The Ajuran confederation begins to form under the Garen lineage, according to tradition
Ibn Battuta visits Mogadishu and praises its cloth trade
The Ottoman corsair Mir Ali Bey wins support on the Benadir coast
Revolts led by Hawiye clans break Ajuran power
The Hiraab Imamate and the Geledi replace the Ajuran
